title: Breakout · Native Development
summary: Native development gameplay with the supplied cartridge's recovered variations, score tables, velocity tiers, five-ball games and team rules. Collision and presentation remain approximations awaiting original comparison.
notes: 12 original variations, 1–4 players, two difficulty switches and native save/resume. One gamepad controls the first active paddle; other paddles use separate keyboard pairs.
Native geometric collisions, colors and paddle sampling need original-game comparison; original sound is not implemented. This is not a completed faithful rewrite.
Development checks ran on the M5 Pro with 24 GB. Mandatory M1 Air / 8 GB performance and physical Fusion Pro input acceptance remain unverified.
keyboard: Drag or Left/Right: first active paddle
Space: serve; hold to catch, release to launch
controller: Left stick / D-pad: first active paddle
A: serve; hold to catch, release to launch
Additional controllers and physical Fusion Pro transitions await validation
